# Dr. Anirach Mingkhwan — anirach.com

> Personal site of Assoc. Prof. Dr. Anirach Mingkhwan (KMUTNB): books, academic
> publications, and a bilingual (Thai/English) blog on AI agents, DevOps, and the
> philosophy of living well. All pages are hand-written static HTML with no
> JavaScript — every word below is server-rendered and crawlable.

## Books & Writing
- [One Day of Light](https://anirach.com/books/one-day-of-light.html): a last-lecture book on life and work — free bilingual PDFs (TH/EN)
- [Three Old Men](https://anirach.com/books/three-old-men.html): published novel, free sample chapter
- [A Pocketful of Questions](https://anirach.com/books/a-pocketful-of-questions.html): complete manuscript
- [The Thirteenth Seal](https://anirach.com/books/the-thirteenth-seal.html): complete manuscript
